clues.title: Auditors spend 4+ hours manually copying commercial lease clauses into Excel
clues.quote: He'll spend 4+ hours going through lease documents, copying numbers into Excel, double-checking calculations that could easily be automated.
clues.persona_context: Small audit firm CPA preparing ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease schedules
clues.input_data: Multi-page commercial lease PDFs and amendments
clues.output_data: ASC 842 amortization Excel workbook with clickable citation links to each PDF clause

clues.title: Agency account managers lose 30 hours/month screenshotting GA4 and Meta Ads into Google Slides
clues.quote: When I was doing this manually it was 2-3 hours per client per month. Multiply by 10 clients and you've lost a full work week to copy-pasting into Google Slides.
clues.persona_context: B2B digital marketing agency account manager
clues.input_data: CSV exports from GA4, Meta Ads, LinkedIn + 3 bullet points from AM
clues.output_data: Branded client Google Slides deck with standardized charts and executive narrative
